name: @btkulka/ui-kit
description: The controls Ben's web apps share, in React and themed by CSS variables: buttons (busy, two-tap confirm), checks that draw themselves, switches and switch rows, a segmented control with a sliding thumb, tiles, chips, tag input, a stepper with press-and-hold, text, search, token-completing and growing fields, a native select, a date strip, bottom sheets that follow a drag down (focus kept inside, keyboard-aware), context menus by long press, right-click or the menu key (popover or action sheet), toasts with Undo and a timer, swipeable rows, lists that unfold, fold and re-sort smoothly, a tab bar with a gliding pill, a page header with a slim sticky bar, disclosure, skeletons, banners, tags, avatars, rows, an icon renderer and an icon picker. Motion settles and never bounces; reduced motion turns it off. No runtime dependencies; React is a peer.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node ../scripts/cjs-marker.mjs && node scripts/assets.mjs
